items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream rights, privacy jurisdiction, and future affiliate or advertising use. Evidence shows Woot API access documentation but no permission for public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, or commercial use; Woot terms point against those uses. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Do not send rights outreach or change the gate without human counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible work may continue only if it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed, so none are closed. Next evidence action: produce the read-only SearchWoot data-flow and retention table from repository and deployed configuration, covering alert rules, identifiers, sync results, Slack/email delivery, retention, deletion, correction, access, and unsubscribe behavior.

Concrete private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No build, publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.

Compliance baseline is technical evidence only: 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown sites, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Do not infer legal clearance. Permit ordinary growth only where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift from aggregate affiliate data.
